mapper.select: select scope, application_id, allowed_max_profile, revision, policy_hash, modified_by, created_at, updated_at from script_capability_policy where scope = #{scope} and application_id = #{applicationId}
select scope, application_id, allowed_max_profile, revision, policy_hash, modified_by, created_at, updated_at from script_capability_policy where scope = 'PLATFORM'

select scope, application_id, allowed_max_profile, revision, policy_hash, modified_by, created_at, updated_at from script_capability_policy where scope = 'APPLICATION' and application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.insert: insert into script_capability_policy(scope, application_id, allowed_max_profile, revision, policy_hash, modified_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{scope}, #{applicationId}, #{allowedMaxProfile}, #{revision}, #{policyHash}, #{modifiedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
